items.title: Execution branch on modern Feed tip
steps: Confirm kylie/feed-profile HEAD equals kylie/messages-friend-picker tip (or documented successor)
Confirm FeedPage has feed-card and What's on your mind? placeholder
items.expected: rg matches feed-card and What's on your mind? in frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx; branch is not ancient main 7ebfbd4.
items.evidence: 2026-07-30: git reset --hard kylie/messages-friend-picker → HEAD 2bec1d0. FeedPage retains feed-card + What's on your mind?.

items.title: Feed header removed
steps: Look at the top of the main content above the composer
items.expected: No “Feed” page title and no “You and your mutuals.” subtitle. Composer is the first signed-in content block.
items.evidence: 2026-07-30 session: user screenshots show composer as first signed-in block; no Feed/subtitle header. Code has no header block.

items.title: Inline avatar + mind prompt
items.precondition: Signed in; preferably with a profile photo set
items.expected: Mini circular avatar on the left; “What’s on your mind?” field inline to its right in the same row.
items.evidence: 2026-07-30 session screenshots: avatar + What's on your mind? inline; user confirmed “okay good” after Rev 8/9 polish.

items.title: Post inline on composer row
items.expected: One row: avatar | What’s on your mind? | Post on the right. No horizontal divider line under the text field; no second action row.
items.evidence: 2026-07-30 session screenshots: Post co-located on composer row; no divider; no Choose File.

items.title: Avatar reflects profile + links home
steps: If you have an avatarUrl, confirm the circle shows that image; else confirm letter fallback
items.expected: Navigates to own profile (/u/{username} or /u/me). Photo matches Profile page avatar source.
items.evidence: 2026-07-30 session screenshots show profile photo in composer/post avatars. Code: Link to /u/{username||me} wrapping ProfileAvatar(user).

items.title: Compose still works
steps: Type a short post in the composer
Confirm the post appears in the feed list
items.evidence: 2026-07-30 session: user created/viewed posts during iteration (e.g. “test”, timestamps “3 minutes ago”); onCompose preserved; typecheck/build green.
items.notes: Rev 2: no image attach from Feed composer.
